items.description: Existing diffuser / grille removal: keynote-4 occurrence inventory
items.basis: 34 keyed locations; leader endpoint verification pending
items.notes: Do not equate new-device totals with demo quantities; preserve existing-to-remain devices.

items.description: Branch duct demolition / removal by size and route
items.basis: Length not yet measured
items.notes: Trace demo branches separately from retained primary ducts / trunks. No invented footage.

items.description: Protect and reconnect retained main trunks and primary risers
items.basis: Scope task, not a measured material quantity
items.notes: Quantify fittings and connections separately; lump-sum task is an estimating packaging choice.

items.description: S1 supply diffuser - consistent 6-inch locations
items.basis: Both plans + schedule: four unconflicted S1 assemblies
items.notes: Imaging, reception/checkout, children area and corridor; White B12; scheduled accessories.

items.description: S1 supply diffuser - HC treatment 103 neck conflict
items.basis: S1 at 100 CFM on both plans
items.notes: M101 6-inch; M111 8-inch; S1 schedule 6-inch.

items.description: S1 supply diffuser - Mechanical 116 neck conflict
items.basis: S1 at 200 CFM on both plans
items.notes: Both plans 8-inch; S1 schedule 6-inch.

items.description: S2 supply diffuser - 8-inch neck / 24 x 24 face
items.basis: 17 unique devices matched between M101 and M111
items.notes: Price SCD basis; damper, insulated backpan, four-way, White B12.

items.description: R1 perforated return grille / 24 x 24 face
items.basis: 21 R1 tags on each plan, deduplicated
items.notes: 22 x 22 return opening; no scheduled damper. Confirm boot interface before fabrication.

items.description: Return boot assembly - note calls for 22 x 12
items.basis: One boot per R1 is an assembly interpretation; geometry unconfirmed
items.notes: Twenty keynotes, but text says all boots; do not use 20 as total.

items.description: Retained diffusers: adjust only, no new purchase
items.basis: M101 keynote 6: 150, 125 and 150 CFM
items.notes: Retained terminals total 425 CFM. Include keyed work despite adjacent shading.

items.description: Transfer-air duct assembly 10 x 10
items.basis: Two distinct 10 x 10 TA assemblies on M101
items.notes: Two assemblies is not duct footage. Offsets, end treatment and supports must be measured / detailed.

items.description: Concealed rectangular supply duct 10 x 8 inches
items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured
items.notes: Galvanized; transitions / offsets and fittings separate.

items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured
items.notes: Galvanized; transitions / offsets and fittings separate.

items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured

items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured
items.notes: Galvanized; transitions / offsets and fittings separate.

items.description: Rigid round supply duct 6 inches
items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured
items.notes: Do not confuse adjacent flex with rigid metal.

items.description: Rigid round supply duct 8 inches
items.basis: Size identified; centerline route not measured
items.notes: Do not confuse adjacent flex with rigid metal.

items.description: R-6 / acoustic flexible connections by final approved diameter
items.basis: Each routed connection remains to be measured
items.notes: Maximum 8 ft per connection, NOT 8 ft automatically per diffuser.

items.description: Takeoff fittings with balancing dampers / extractors
items.basis: Count each applicable takeoff; some branches feed multiple diffusers
items.notes: Do not assume exactly one main takeoff per new diffuser.

items.description: Round elbows, reducers, couplings and end caps
items.basis: Fitting-by-fitting trace required
items.notes: Avoid combining with rectangular fittings or installed assembly pricing.

items.description: Rectangular elbows, turning/splitter vanes and transitions
items.basis: Fitting-by-fitting trace required
items.notes: Include concealed field offsets only as explicit measured or approved allowance items.

items.description: 1-1/2-inch foil-faced concealed duct wrap
items.basis: Surface takeoff requires measured dimensions / lengths
items.notes: Rectangular bare area = perimeter x length; round bare area = pi x diameter x length. Lap, thickness / stretch-out, fittings and waste separately documented.

items.description: Duct hangers, attachment hardware and painted supports
items.basis: Hanger counts require run lengths / fitting and end support review
items.notes: 8-ft or 6-ft maximum spacing as applicable; do not use floor(length/spacing) alone.

items.description: Mastic, clamps, connection hardware and consumables
items.basis: Estimating packaging allowance basis; not a plan-counted quantity
items.source: M001 Flexible Duct and Metal Ductwork
items.notes: Build from actual assemblies or price as explicit approved allowance; no duplicate included hardware.

items.description: Existing dual-inlet VAV assessment / reuse scope
items.basis: Eight existing VAVs on demo and new plans
items.notes: These are not eight new VAVs. Actual relocation / piping / restoration task scope unresolved.

items.description: Existing thermostat / zone symbol inventory
items.basis: Eight T symbols on M101, not a confirmed eight-relocation work order
items.notes: Six relocation-keynote placements; two adjacent reception T symbols. Confirm physical moves and zone mappings.

items.description: Pneumatic tubing extensions and controls modifications
items.basis: Routing and lengths not field verified
items.notes: Separate from electrical branch power and dental compressed-air distribution.

items.description: Building controls vendor / BMS graphics scope
items.basis: Named-vendor scope quote required
items.source: M001 Automatic Temperature Controls; M101 keynote 1
items.notes: Do not assume new DDC boxes from a generic graphics note.

items.description: Dental vacuum exhaust route - 2-inch pipe
items.basis: Route shown, length / interface not confirmed
items.notes: HVAC-side intake/exhaust only; equipment utility distribution remains excluded.

items.description: Dental compressor outdoor-air intake - 2-inch pipe
items.basis: Route shown, length / interface not confirmed
items.notes: Protect intake; applicable kit/model and drain details require assignment.

items.description: 3-inch vacuum exhaust wall termination
items.basis: M101 keynote 5
items.notes: FAMCO SDWV3 scheduled basis; field neck and 2-to-3-inch connection to verify.

items.description: 3-inch compressor intake wall termination
items.basis: M101 keynote 8
items.notes: Do not assume exhaust backdraft-damper assembly is correct for intake.

items.description: Relocation of existing dental vacuum / compressor / separator
items.basis: Mechanical note indicates work; responsible trade unresolved
items.notes: Not new equipment purchasing. Written allocation to mechanical or dental/plumbing vendor required.

items.description: Hydronic piping / VAV water-coil work and water TAB
items.basis: Specifications mention work; plans identify dual-inlet boxes
items.source: M001 Work Included / Balancing; MD101 keynote 1
items.notes: HVAC hydronics are not automatically excluded as plumbing, but applicability is unresolved.

items.description: Existing-condition survey and field coordination
items.basis: Required mechanical scope task
items.notes: Account for access, measurements, written deficiency reporting and coordination.

items.description: Pre-demolition air balance survey and baseline report
items.basis: Mandatory specification requirement
items.notes: All affected systems / terminals; do not skip because later text says encouraged.

items.description: Postconstruction TAB and combined report
items.basis: Mandatory specification requirement
items.notes: Preliminary scheduled supply sum 3,765 CFM is a reconciliation only, not a field TAB report.

items.description: Temporary return media / construction protection
items.basis: Required task; extent to survey
items.notes: Avoid counting permanent filters in this line.

items.description: Final HVAC equipment filters by size/type
items.basis: Affected equipment filter sizes/counts not supplied
items.notes: Survey actual equipment; do not assume 8 filters for 8 VAV boxes.

items.description: Required access doors / fire dampers / firestop assemblies
items.basis: Locations and ratings need mechanical coordination information
items.source: M001 Access Doors and Fire Ratings
items.notes: Split into individual rated assemblies and quantities after RFI response.

items.description: Mechanical permits, inspections and required tests
items.basis: Required task; actual fees not provided
items.notes: Enter actual pricing; do not borrow another project fee.

items.description: Mechanical cutting, patching and support / equipment touchup
items.basis: Scope listed; trade split / extent unresolved
items.notes: GC mounting of access doors and exposed duct field painting noted separately.

items.description: Applicable submittals, record drawings, owner training and warranty
items.basis: Project requirements; deliverable extent to verify
items.source: M001 Operating Instructions, Guarantee, As-built Note
items.notes: No assertion that owner training or records have already been provided.

items.description: Domestic water, sanitary, vent, plumbing fixtures and filtration
items.basis: User-requested plumbing exclusion
items.source: User trade boundary; M101 enlarged room; M601
items.notes: Mechanical-sheet placement does not bring plumbing into this estimate.

items.description: Dental vacuum / compressed-air utility distribution and dental plumbing
items.basis: User-requested plumbing / non-HVAC exclusion pending assignment
items.notes: Do not confuse these utility systems with HVAC pneumatic thermostat tubing or dedicated equipment intake/exhaust.

items.description: Electrical branch circuits, line-voltage wiring and electrical trade work
items.basis: User-requested electrical exclusion; specification conflict remains
items.source: User trade boundary; M001 Work Included
items.notes: Needs agreed written scope split. Pneumatic HVAC controls / integration are not automatically excluded.

requirements.requirement: Complete pre-demolition supply, return and exhaust airflow survey of systems serving the work area; submit baseline report before demolition.
Complete final TAB of affected systems; report pre/post airflows, procedures, deficiencies and corrective actions. Final quantities equal or exceed baseline unless otherwise indicated or approved.
